tools.name: search
tools.description: Cerca informazioni nella memoria dell'utente. Restituisce risultati con id, titolo e url da citare.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Recupera il contenuto completo di un elemento dato il suo id (ottenuto da search).

tools.name: cortex_recall
tools.description: Riassume cio che la memoria contiene su un argomento.

tools.name: cortex_forget

tools.name: cortex_conflicts
tools.description: Mostra le contraddizioni rilevate tra le memorie.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "cortex_write" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "cortex_forget" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Forget (permanently delete) a memory, given its id. Ask the user for confirmation before calling this tool: the deletion cannot be undone.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
